references.text: Moses exhorts the people to take care of their souls and remember the Lord's deeds, the same theme of guarding oneself carefully.
The great commandment to love the Lord your God with all your heart, which Joshua here reminds the people of.
Moses asks what the Lord requires, and the answer includes loving and serving the Lord, the same reminder Joshua gives.
The promise of blessing when the people love the Lord and serve him, linked to Joshua's exhortation.
Moses commands the people to keep the commandments, love the Lord, and walk in his ways, parallel to Joshua's words.
The Lord will circumcise their hearts so that they may love him, fulfilling what Joshua exhorts them to do.
To love the Lord is life, the same message about the importance of loving God that Joshua proclaims.
Jesus quotes the greatest commandment to love the Lord your God, which is the core of Joshua's exhortation.
Jesus repeats the command to love the Lord with all your heart, the same love Joshua reminds them of.
All things work together for good for those who love God, the fruit of the love that Joshua exhorts.
